title: Design System: LoL A–Z Challenge Tracker

hex-track.role: Empty part of each A→Z segment, on the page and the share card.

loss-ink.role: Body text inside the loss-tinted import error box.

display.purpose: The current champion's name in the Spotlight only.

headline.purpose: Section heads (Trophy shelf, roster); About and settings legends are smaller steps of the same face.

letter-divider.purpose: A–Z divider rows in the roster ledger, in gold.

title.purpose: Spotlight subtitle line and import recap summary.

name.purpose: Champion names in roster rows and recap items.

stat.purpose: Record and last-game figures in the Spotlight, tabular.

body.purpose: Running text, meta lines, table cells.

label.purpose: Small buttons, chips, segments, table headers.

field-label.purpose: Label above every form field, dim.

shadows.name: dialog-drop
shadows.purpose: Share dialog, over an 82% Void Black overlay.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: The single easing for every transition and reveal.

motion.name: hover
motion.purpose: Button and control hover transitions (160–200ms; chevrons 200ms, shelf lift 180ms).

motion.name: rise
motion.purpose: Run settings, import options, roster detail reveal; the recap uses 360ms.

motion.name: spotlight-body-in
motion.purpose: Spotlight text column on champion change.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Every animation and transition duration under prefers-reduced-motion.

narrative.overview:
The tracker reads like an engraved ledger kept inside the League client: a near-black navy field, thin gold hairlines that rule the page into sections, and one champion's splash art bleeding in from the right as if lit from behind the glass. The current champion is the hero; everything else (the trophy shelf, the alphabet roster) sits beneath it as record-keeping. Density is calm at the top and tight below: the Spotlight breathes, the roster is a compact table with letter dividers.

Ornament comes from type and line, never from effects. Cinzel carries names and section heads with carved, inscriptional weight; Marcellus softens labels and champion names; the platform sans handles every number and control, always with tabular figures. Color is almost entirely gold-on-navy, with three signals that each mean exactly one thing: teal is now (the current champion and anything live), green is a win, red is a loss.

Corners are square or nearly so. Depth is drawn with hairlines and tonal steps, with a soft dark drop shadow only on surfaces that float above the page (Run settings, the toast, the share dialog).
keyCharacteristics: Near-black navy ground with gold hairline rules dividing every region.
Splash art masked into the field from the right; a navy scrim keeps the text column clean.
Cinzel display at up to 6rem for the current champion; Marcellus for names and field labels; system sans with tabular figures for data.
Teal = current/live, green = win, red = loss; gold for everything structural and the primary action.
Square panels, 2px control corners, no nested cards.
Motion is a short rise on reveal and a slow fill on the A→Z track; all of it collapses under reduced motion.

rules.name: The One Meaning Rule
rules.body: Teal means now, green means won, red means lost. None of the three is used decoratively, and no fourth signal color exists.

rules.name: The Gold Fill Rule
rules.body: A solid gold fill marks the one primary action in its region (Import, Apply, Download) or the pressed segment of a segmented control. Everything else is outlined or ghosted.

rules.name: The Tinted Signal Rule
rules.body: A signal color used as a background appears only as a low tint of itself (teal at 6–10%, green and red at 8%) behind a full-strength border or text of the same hue.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Every number (positions, records, KDA, counts, dates in tables) is set with tabular figures, via the `num` utility or on the whole ledger.

rules.name: The Carved Names Rule
rules.body: Serif faces are for names and headings. Numbers, buttons and running text never use Cinzel.

rules.name: The Hairline-First Rule
rules.body: Separate regions with a 1px gold rule or a tonal step before reaching for a shadow. A shadow means the surface floats.

rules.name: The No-Glow Rule
rules.body: Shadows are black, never colored. No glows around buttons, art or text.

dos: Do rule regions with 1px gold hairlines (Engraved Line, Hairline Gold) and step the navy tones for depth.
Do keep teal for the current champion and live state, green for wins, red for losses (The One Meaning Rule).
Do give each region at most one gold-filled action (The Gold Fill Rule).
Do set every number in tabular figures and every name or heading in Cinzel or Marcellus.
Do mask Data Dragon splash art into the field and back the text with a navy scrim so it never fights the controls.
Do use the shared ease-out and the short rise for reveals, and honor reduced motion.
donts: Don't use gradient text, colored glows, or nested bordered cards.
Don't round panels or containers; controls stop at 2px.
Don't introduce a fourth accent hue or use teal, green or red as decoration.
Don't set numbers, buttons or body copy in Cinzel.
Don't add shadows to surfaces that sit in the page flow.
